info.title: Update The Blind Box Opening Results
info.description: After the merchant completes blind box opening in a live room, use this callback to send blind box and batch box opening results for an order back to the platform. Buyers can then view the unboxing results in the order details.

post.summary: Update The Blind Box Opening Results
post.description: After the merchant completes blind box opening in a live room, use this callback to send blind box and batch box opening results for an order back to the platform. Buyers can then view the unboxing results in the order details.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

main_order_id.description: The unique identifier for a TikTok Shop order.

order_line_id.description: Line item id in TikTok Shop.

blind_result_product_id.description: Unboxing results corresponding to TikTok Shop product id.

blind_result_sku_id.description: Unboxing results corresponding to TikTok Shop sku id.

blind_open_time.description: Unboxing timestamp. Only UNIX format is accepted.

blind_box_results.description: Unboxing results for line items under orders.

order_line_id.description: Line item id in TikTok Shop.

blind_result_product_id.description: Unboxing results corresponding to TikTok Shop product id.

blind_result_sku_id.description: Unboxing results corresponding to TikTok Shop sku id.

blind_open_time.description: Unboxing timestamp. Only UNIX format is accepted.

product_type.description:
Unboxing product type.
Possible values:
- `NORMAL` (`0`): A normal unboxed product.
- `GIFT` (`1`): A gift unboxed product.

blind_box_order_line_list.description: Unboxing results for line items under orders. on batch box version

blind_batch_box_results.description: Unboxing batch results for line items under orders.
